chapter: Caravan, Perdido and the first tunes
title: Rose praises the tunes; Perdido written on a train
summary: Rose praises Gypsy Without a Song and Lost in Meditation, and Tizol says Perdido was written on a coach seat and handed to Duke.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: "Gypsy Without a Song" is That was a beautiful tune; beautiful.

You know, "Perdido" was written on the train, on a coach train. I wrote "Perdido" and "Jeffries" was next to me in the seat in the coach, and I started singing this thing to him and he started singing it, too, and I gave it to Duke.
